schema.description: Request body for Bria Add Object by Text API

example.instruction: Place a red vase with flowers next to the pie

image.description: The image to edit. Supported input types are Base64-encoded string or URL pointing to a publicly accessible image file. Accepted formats JPEG, JPG, PNG, WEBP.

instruction.description: A text instruction that describes the object to add and its position (for example, "Place a red vase with flowers on the table").
